characters.name: Avenor
characters.role: The half-demon child who arrives with the royal sword and accepts bounded regency
characters.form: Young human-demon mixed-heritage person, gender unstated

selectionEvidence.quote: They were perhaps fourteen, perhaps younger beneath the dirt.
Their eyes were dark red around human-gray irises.
Their horn tips curved back close to the skull, one ridged, one chipped.
selectionEvidence.explanation: Small asymmetric horns, final hood-off view.

storyAppearance.physical: Perhaps fourteen, short stature, travel dirt and sweat, two blunt horn tips; dark red around human-gray irises; horn tips curve back close to skull, one ridged one chipped.
storyAppearance.clothing: Torn hood, coat with overlapping red leather scales on one shoulder and square human-made patches on other, trousers and boots.
storyAppearance.equipment: Too-long royal sword in scabbard; blue enamel pommel burned brown one side, partly melted guard, black-cord repair and copper knot in grip. Battered iron disk signet, diagonal groove dividing polished/stippled halves.

visualInterpretation: Art-only name Avenor, gender left unspecified. Retain cover's shaggy black hair, pale olive complexion, slight young build, weathered charcoal layers and small back-curving horns.
Two views use pre-surrender sword-belt state. Hood off in bust only, no crown or throne. Sword remains ordinary non-glowing metal.
